To contest this block, please [[Wookieepedia:Contact|contact]] the blocking administrator with the reason you believe the block is unjustified. {{{2|}}}<!-- Template:Blocked --><noinclude>

==Usage==
To be subst'ed on user talk pages following a temporary block. Example usage would be '''<nowiki>{{Subst:Blocked|2 weeks}}</nowiki>'''. For long-term bans, use {{Tl|Banned}}.

There's an optional second parameter which can be included for a signature: '''<nowiki>{{Subst:Blocked|2 weeks|~~~~}}</nowiki>'''
